name: Hoshiyomi no Tsumugu Uta
source:
An old street with a sizzling atmosphere, a sea of wheat that seems to last forever, and a lightless business district.
The smell of gunpowder can no longer be felt as of now, but its traces have surely become indelible wounds engraved throughout this world.

In the midst of the seemingly eternal lonely scenery, the two travel to anywhere they want to be, needing nothing but an occasional warmth felt by the other person's touch.

It was a journey that “digs back into the past”.
A boy and a girl with mysterious power - Kamitaira Rei and Inamori Aruru.

They, despite some rebellious moments, continue to move forward
To uncover the history's hidden truth,
To unearth the feelings of people who are intertwined
Eventually, the scattered pieces become one big flow,
Marking the beginning of a new world...

[Translated from the [url=http://n-hsc.com/?page_id=528]official site[/url]]
translation:
一条热气腾腾的老街，一片仿佛永远长存的麦海，还有一片漆黑的商业区。
火药的味道现在已经闻不到了，但它的痕迹却注定成为刻在这个世界上不可磨灭的伤口。

在看似永恒的孤独风景中，两人前往任何想去的地方，只需要对方偶尔的抚摸带来的温暖。

这是一次“挖掘过去”的旅程。
拥有神秘力量的少年和少女——上平丽和稻森阿鲁鲁。

尽管有一些叛逆的时刻，他们仍然继续前进
为了揭开历史隐藏的真相，
挖掘纠缠在一起的人们的感情
最终，零散的碎片成为一大流，
标志着一个新世界的开始……

[翻译自[url=http://n-hsc.com/?page_id=528]官方网站[/url]]
